summary: Phase 3 (WebAuthn passkeys + real statement upload) tested end-to-end. Backend: 55 pytest cases across new test_phase3.py (22), test_phase3_passkey_state.py (1) plus phase-2 regression suites (33) — 54 passed / 1 failed. Frontend: full Playwright E2E — sign-in, Statements CSV upload (preview → map → review → import → transactions visible), unsupported-file error, Settings passkey section, real passkey registration via Chrome DevTools virtual authenticator (register → list → DELETE → has_passkey reset), goal creation, Ask Finaura streaming chat, sign-out, /demo public access. Only defect found: PDF DR/CR type detection mis-classifies every row as Income.

minor.issue: parse_pdf() DR/CR hint detection uses padded substrings (' dr ', ' cr ') so a line-terminal marker like '01/08/2026 SWIGGY DINNER 450.00 DR' is never matched -> _detect_type() sees a positive amount and returns Income. Result: every PDF debit row is imported as Income (and category becomes 'Income'). The marker also leaks into the description ('SWIGGY DINNER DR'). Repro: tests/test_phase3.py::TestStatements::test_pdf_preview (reportlab-generated plain PDF). Fix: match with word-boundary regex r'\b(dr|debit|withdrawal)\b' / r'\b(cr|credit|deposit)\b' on the line and strip the trailing DR/CR token from the description.

issues: The dropzone uses the raw native <input type=file> ('Choose File / No file chosen') inside an otherwise polished card — visually inconsistent with the rest of the design system; wrap it in a styled label/button and add drag-and-drop.
The dropzone does not visually shrink/hide after import; only the success panel replaces it (acceptable, noted for polish).
Goal cards have no edit/delete affordance even though PATCH/DELETE /api/goals/{id} exist — a created goal cannot be removed from the UI (pre-existing gap, not Phase 3).

action_items: Fix parse_pdf() DR/CR detection (word-boundary regex) and strip the DR/CR token from the extracted description — currently all PDF debits import as Income.
Optional polish: style the statement file input as a real dropzone (drag & drop) instead of the native Choose File control.
Optional: expose goal edit/delete in the Goals UI (backend already supports it).
critical_code_review_comments: statements.py POST /statements/parse has no size guard — only /preview enforces the 10 MB limit; a client can POST a 100 MB file straight to /parse. Duplicate the size/415 checks or extract a shared validator.

statements.py confirm-import skips rows where amount is falsy via `not t.get('amount')` — a legitimate 0-amount row and a missing key are treated the same; prefer explicit `t.get('amount') in (None, '')` plus float() validation, and validate the transaction shape with a Pydantic model instead of list[dict].
confirm-import trusts client-supplied type/category strings without an enum check — a crafted payload can insert arbitrary category values that break the dashboard aggregations.

passkeys.py register/complete consumes (marks used) the challenge before verification succeeds, so a single failed browser attempt forces the user to restart from /register/begin. Acceptable for replay safety, but surface a clearer 'please try again' message in the UI.

passkeys.py authenticate/complete returns {ok:true} but does not mint/refresh any token — unlock state is purely client-side (sessionStorage), so a caller can skip the passkey step entirely. Consider returning a short-lived unlock token if the lock screen is meant to be a real gate.
PDF parsing dependency (pdfplumber) is imported lazily and raises 500 when missing; return 503/415 with a clearer message instead of 500.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: (1) all 5 passkey endpoints 401 without JWT; register/begin returns rp.id=wealth-insights-43.preview.emergentagent.com, 43+ char challenge, real user id/email; register/complete with bogus attestation -> 400; authenticate/begin -> 404 with no creds; DELETE unknown prefix -> 404; webauthn_challenges TTL index (expires_at, expireAfterSeconds=0) present. (2) Full passkey happy path DOES work headless via CDP: `cdp = await page.context.new_cdp_session(page); await cdp.send('WebAuthn.enable'); await cdp.send('WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator', {'options': {'protocol':'ctap2','transport':'internal','hasResidentKey':True,'hasUserVerification':True,'isUserVerified':True,'automaticPresenceSimulation':True}})` then accept the window.prompt dialog — registration succeeded and appeared in the list. (3) Statements: CSV preview (kind=csv, total_rows=6, guess date/debit/credit), parse (6 txns, 1 Income 80000, categories Food/Shopping/Transport/Entertainment/Rent all correct), Excel preview+parse, confirm-import persists and shows in /api/financial/overview (no _id leakage), .txt -> 415 (surfaced in UI as upload-error), >10MB -> 413. (4) UI: statement-upload, demo-shortcut-button, upload-mapping-step with pre-filled guesses, review-txn-N, upload-import-button -> 'Imported 3 transactions', rows visible in the table below; passkey-section renders (Chromium supports WebAuthn so passkey-not-supported badge is absent and add-passkey-button shows); unlock-with-passkey-button correctly not rendered (no PIN/passkey). Only open bug: PDF DR/CR -> Income. Ask Finaura chat input testid is ask-finaura-input and the endpoint streams plain text (not JSON) — use requests stream/r.text in pytest.
rca_of_the_issue: parse_pdf() derives the debit/credit hint with `' dr ' in lowered` style substring checks. Bank statement lines almost always end with the DR/CR marker, so the padded substring never matches, hint stays None, and _detect_type(positive amount, None) returns ('Income', amount). Consequence: 100% of PDF-extracted debits are classified as Income and inflate income totals after import. Reproduce with tests/test_phase3.py::TestStatements::test_pdf_preview.
